Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class ProcessDiagramDocumentSetAdapter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.ProcessDiagramDocumentSetAdapter
public final class ProcessDiagramDocumentSetAdapter extends Object
Creates immutable controlled diagram-document proposals from runnable NeqSim process objects.

The adapter reuses ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter; it does not change scheduling, existing Graphviz output, DEXPI writers, or Proteus/P&ID APIs.
